svg.title: Proof board: skeleton graph, motion signal and annotation statistics
svg.desc: Three panels built from repository data. Left: the 17-node, 16-edge COCO skeleton graph with the symmetric normalisation used by the spatial graph convolution. Middle: the real left-elbow angle trace of biceps_biceps_003 with one 30-frame window highlighted. Right: counts of labelled repetitions per class, form labels and split sizes from data/annotations/unified_reps.csv.
svg.text: PROOF — REAL OUTPUTS FROM THIS REPOSITORY
12 angles per frame feed the angle branch
